surface_mechanism_description: Nitrogen incorporation during PE–ALD HfO2 by nitrogen addition to oxygen plasma, producing a PE–ALD HfOxNy film. The modulation of nitrogen concentrations was feasible by changing the N/O flow ratio.
intermediate_species: Nitrogen incorporated into HfO2 during plasma reaction
evidence: Thus, nitrogen is easily incorporated during the PE–ALD HfO2 by nitrogen addition to oxygen plasma, producing a PE–ALD HfOxNy film. The modulation of nitrogen concentrations was feasible by changing the N/O flow ratio.
